title: Best Black Friday TV deal: Save $650 on the LG 85-Inch QNED AI 4K Smart TV in the Amazon Black Friday sale.
excerpt: A seriously impressive 4K TV at a record-low price.
content_html:
SAVE $650: As of Nov. 22, the LG 85-Inch QNED AI 4K Smart TV is marked down to $749.99 in the Amazon Black Friday sale. That's a 46% discount on the list price of $1,399.99.

Credit: LG

$749.99 at Amazon
$1,399.99 Save $650

The Black Friday sales are here, and we all know what that means: mega savings on mega TVs. It's all part of the holiday shopping tradition. And TVs don't come much more mega than the LG 85-Inch QNED AI 4K Smart TV. Not only is it huge, but LG is well regarded as one of the best names in cutting-edge TV technology.

As of Nov. 22, the LG 85-Inch QNED AI 4K Smart TV is marked down to $749.99, a 46% discount from the regular list price of $1,399.99. That's an impressive savings of $650.

The best tech deal this week

This AI-powered TV combines mini LED technology, Dynamic QNED Color, and HDR10 Pro to deliver a vivid, highly detailed picture.

It's also a great model for both movie fans and gamers, with a Filmmaker Mode for optimizing your movies — so they look and sound just like the director intended — plus dedicated features for next-gen gaming. It also gives you a sports hub plus near-endless content via all your favorite streaming apps and channels.
